answer: A cliff-path weather post will not issue a second wind flag to a pile of fresh aliases. A watcher claims one stand by logging a 90-second zephyr reading on a 1.85-meter mast, then seating a single ivory cap whose inner diameter at 16 C is 18.20 to 18.40 millimeters, while a raven-stamped cloth tag stays pinned to the stay wire. A reused cap serial, a reading miss past 0.4 meters per second, or a second flag burns the 27.8 POA bond and closes that post for eight nights.
